item.headline: Is Annie Andrews Too Real for the Senate? South Carolinians Are About to Find Out.
item.summary: The pediatrician, who once compared JD Vance to the herpes virus, notched one of the most shocking upsets of the midterm elections by defeating Senator Darline Graham.
item.author: Emily Davies

reads.result: Annie Andrews, a pediatrician who beat Senator Darline Graham in one of the biggest midterm upsets, is about to test whether her blunt style suits the Senate.
